Profile Settings

Resume Mode
How to handle saved watch progress on playback.
Subtitles
Start playback with subtitles on or off. Default follows the admin setting.
Global Applies to every profile
Intensity
How hard to flatten the loud–quiet gap.
Use My Computer
Pause the background video and stop VLC from taking over the screen or minimizing your windows, so you can use the computer normally.
Paused
Max Volume
Hard cap applied to the player and to VLC at startup.
200%
VLC Starting Volume
Volume VLC opens at, as a % of the max-volume cap. Default 50% (half max).
50%
Host Volume
Drives the host OS mixer in real time. Reflects (and overrides) the speaker volume on the machine running StreamLink.
—
YouTube Starting Volume
Host OS volume pre-set the moment a YouTube link starts playing, before the first frame produces audio. Keeps videos from blasting at system max.
30%
System Volume After YouTube
Host OS volume restored when a YouTube play stops. The dashboard slider drives the system volume while YouTube is playing.
70%
This Device Saved in this browser only
Device Name
What your other devices call this one when it's playing something — "Playing on Nathan's iPhone". Leave it empty to use the automatic name.
Library View
Show your library as poster cards or as a detailed list. Every action stays available in both — the list shows them inline, cards tuck them behind a button.
Offline Sync
Push watch progress recorded offline to the server now, and show exactly what happened (for troubleshooting).

Heads up

Prepping files for streaming is CPU-heavy.

"Prep" converts this title into a format your phone, tablet or computer can play directly — so you can watch it on this device (and download it for offline).

While files are being prepared, the server will get laggy and can become unusable at times — playback, search and downloads may stutter.

You can pause at any time from the indicator in the top-right and resume later. The admin can also set this to run automatically when the box is idle.
